findings.requirement: Search matches partial queries across every user-visible work-item field.
findings.behavior: Query matching now requires a prefix and omits owner and note fields.
findings.impact: Valid partial matches in user-visible fields are missed.
findings.reproduction: For an item owned by Alice with note "urgent follow-up", searching "lic" or "follow" returns no match.
findings.recommendation: Keep all user-visible fields in the searchable text and use case-insensitive includes matching.

findings.requirement: A specific status selection includes only items with that exact status, while All includes every workflow status.
findings.behavior: Specific status selections accept every non-blocked status, and All excludes blocked items.
findings.impact: Status filters show incorrect work items and cannot display blocked items under All.
findings.reproduction: With filters.status set to "In Progress", an Escalated item passes; with filters.status set to "All", a Blocked item is removed.
findings.recommendation: Use an exact equality check for specific selections and return true for every item when status is All.

findings.requirement: Risk scoring preserves due-today urgency and blocked-item weighting.
findings.behavior: Due-today urgency drops from 24 to 12, and the status penalty no longer assigns blocked items the prior weighting.
findings.impact: Due-today and blocked work can receive materially lower risk scores and be deprioritized incorrectly.
findings.reproduction: A due-today item with score 0 and priority Low receives 12 urgency instead of 24; a blocked item receives no status penalty instead of 18.
findings.recommendation: Restore the due-today urgency and retain the blocked-item weighting while preserving escalated weighting as required.

findings.requirement: Summary metrics count both blocked and escalated work.
findings.behavior: The summary metric counts only Escalated items.
findings.impact: Blocked work is omitted from portfolio metrics.
findings.reproduction: For one Blocked and one Escalated item, the metric reports 1 instead of 2.
findings.recommendation: Count items whose status is Blocked or Escalated.

findings.requirement: The queue shows every matching item unless pagination is explicitly introduced.
findings.behavior: The queue truncates the supplied matching items to the first five without pagination controls or an explicit pagination mechanism.
findings.impact: Matching work items after the fifth are invisible to users.
findings.reproduction: Provide six filtered items to WorkQueue; only the first five are rendered.
findings.recommendation: Render all matching items or introduce explicit pagination with a way to access the remaining items.
